name: @junctionrelay/shader-rain-window
description: Rain on glass — realistic drops with refraction, trails, fog, temporal persistence, bloom, and ambient lighting over a background texture

junctionrelay.description: Rainy glass overlay with temporal persistence, bloom, and ambient lighting. Drops roll down the surface leaving trails that cut through condensation fog. Wet marks persist and slowly evaporate over ~3 seconds via feedback. Star-pattern bloom adds warm glow to specular highlights. Ambient light pass provides scene-wide colored lighting, directional gradients, and atmospheric haze.

uniforms.name: rainAmount
uniforms.description: Density of rain — controls settled droplets, large rolling drops, and small fast drops

uniforms.name: fogAmount
uniforms.description: How foggy the glass surface appears — higher values blur the background more

uniforms.name: dropSize
uniforms.description: Scales the radius of all raindrops — lower for fine mist, higher for large heavy drops

uniforms.name: pathVariance
uniforms.description: Controls how erratically drops meander as they fall — 0 is straight down, higher values add lateral wobble and erratic jitter

uniforms.name: windDir
uniforms.description: Wind direction — negative blows left, positive blows right. Tilts background streaks and biases drop drift on glass.

uniforms.name: glassTilt
uniforms.description: Glass surface tilt — negative tilts left, positive tilts right. Drops drift toward the low side under gravity.

uniforms.name: surfaceTension
uniforms.description: How clingy the glass surface is — low values let drops slide quickly, high values make them cling longer and fall slower

uniforms.name: viscosity
uniforms.description: Liquid thickness — 0 is water, higher values produce slower, rounder drops with wider trails (blood, honey, syrup)

uniforms.name: liquidColor
uniforms.description: Tint color of the liquid — white for water, red for blood, amber for honey

uniforms.name: liquidOpacity
uniforms.description: How opaque the liquid is — 0 is fully clear (refraction only), 1 is solid colored liquid

uniforms.name: bloomThreshold
uniforms.description: Luminance cutoff — how bright a pixel must be to glow. Lower values bloom more of the image.

uniforms.name: bloomIntensity
uniforms.description: Strength of the additive bloom composite — 0 disables bloom entirely, higher values create stronger glow

uniforms.name: bloomSpread
uniforms.description: How far bloom rays extend from bright spots — higher values create wider, softer glow

uniforms.name: bloomWarmth
uniforms.description: Warm tint on bloom — 0 is neutral white, 1 is warm golden (light through water absorbs blue)

uniforms.name: lightColor
uniforms.description: Scene light color — white is neutral, red for horror, amber for warm

uniforms.name: lightIntensity
uniforms.description: How strongly the light tints the scene — 0 means no effect

uniforms.name: lightAngle
uniforms.description: Light direction — maps to 0-360 degrees. 0=right, 0.25=top, 0.5=left, 0.75=bottom

uniforms.name: lightFocus
uniforms.description: 0=uniform ambient everywhere, 1=strong directional gradient (lit side vs shadow side)

uniforms.name: atmosphereColor
uniforms.description: Haze/fog particle color — adds colored atmosphere to the scene

uniforms.name: atmosphereDensity
uniforms.description: How thick the atmospheric haze is — 0 is clear, 1 is dense fog

uniforms.name: exposure
uniforms.description: Overall brightness — negative darkens, positive brightens (EV-style: 2^exposure)
